notes.title: The artwork's on your computer
notes.notes:
Want to save the artwork to your computer?
Now it's possible!

We have made DLC that gives you this possibility.
[i]The DLC format is for advertising the product and nothing more.[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3446590/Hentai_Office__Arts/

You need to add the DLC to your account and you will see a button to save all the arts to your computer in the main menu. Click on it and wait for the end of saving and enjoy the arts. 
[u]If an error occurs when saving, try to install the game on another drive, it may be due to limited write and read permissions on your drive. Or try to run the game as administrator.[/u]

All arts will be saved in the [b]Gallery folder in the game directory[/b].

[b]It will be in all of our puzzles soon![/b]

Also do not miss our new puzzle :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3420510/Hentai_Step_Milf/
